title: Nairobi Street Sprint: Avenue Challenge
briefing: Welcome to this Nairobi-inspired city sprint on the existing Matrix Avenue route. Pass every checkpoint in order. Contact adds the native collision penalty; manually recovering your car adds five seconds. Both drivers use the same road-car preset. The race engine verifies your finish time and penalties.

radio.start: Green flag is out. Keep it clean and watch your lines on the Avenue.
radio.finish: Finish confirmed by the race engine. Compare your time and penalties.
